title.en: How the bishop moves

explain.ja: 角は斜めにどこまでも進めます。飛車に次いで強力な駒と言われています。
explain.en: The bishop moves any distance diagonally. It is said to be the strongest piece after the rook.

section.ja: 角の動き方、斜めにどこまでも進める
section.en: How the bishop moves: any distance diagonally

title.en: How the horse moves

explain.ja: 角が成ると馬になり、斜め移動に加えて縦横の4方向にも1マスずつ動けるようになります。
explain.en: A promoted bishop becomes a horse, which adds one-square moves in the four orthogonal directions to its diagonal moves.

section.ja: 馬の動き方、成ると斜めにも
section.en: How the horse moves: also diagonally once promoted

title.en: Figure 1-1: ▲7六歩 opens the bishop's diagonal

explain.ja: ▲7六歩(後手なら△3四歩)と指すと角の斜めのラインが開き、角の動ける範囲が一気に広がります。これを「角道を開ける」と言います。1手で角の利きが敵陣まで伸びるので、それだけで相手を牽制できます。「攻めは飛角銀桂」と言うように、角は基本的に敵陣を狙う攻め駒です。
explain.en: Playing ▲7六歩 (△3四歩 for White) opens the bishop's diagonal and greatly widens its range; this is called opening the bishop's diagonal. With one move the bishop's reach extends into the enemy camp, which restrains the opponent. As "attack with rook, bishop, silver and knight" says, the bishop is basically an attacking piece aimed at the enemy camp.

section.ja: 角道を開けて牽制しよう!
section.en: Open the bishop diagonal to keep the opponent in check

title.en: Figure 1-2: Example of a bishop exchange

explain.ja: お互いに角道を開けた状態では、いつでも角で角を取って持ち駒にし合う手が生まれ、これを「角交換」と言います。たとえば図1-2は、初手から▲7六歩、△3四歩、▲2二角成、△同銀と進んで角交換した局面です。
explain.en: When both sides have opened their bishop diagonals, either can capture the other's bishop with a bishop at any time; this is a bishop exchange (角交換). Figure 1-2 shows one, reached by ▲7六歩, △3四歩, ▲2二角成, △同銀 from the first move.

title.ja: 図1-3 角道を閉じてしまうのも手
title.en: Figure 1-3: Closing the bishop's diagonal is also an option

explain.ja: 角交換をすると、お互いに好きなマスに角を打てるようになり、一気に勝負が複雑になります。そのため、図1-3のように▲6六歩とあえて角道を閉じて角交換できないようにするのも立派な作戦です。
explain.en: After a bishop exchange both sides can drop a bishop on any square, which makes the game much more complicated. Deliberately closing the bishop's diagonal with ▲6六歩, as in Figure 1-3, so that no exchange is possible is a valid strategy.

title.en: Figure 1-4: Boat castle

explain.ja: 角は攻め駒として使うと説明しましたが、成った馬は守りの駒としても優秀です。たとえば図1-4では、先手が舟囲いを組んでいます。
explain.en: The bishop was described as an attacker, but the horse it promotes into is an excellent defensive piece too. In Figure 1-4 Black has built a Funagakoi (boat castle).

section.en: The horse can also be used for defense

title.en: Figure 1-5: The boat castle collapses

explain.ja: 後手には△8六桂と桂馬を捨てて一気に攻める手筋があり、これで舟囲いが崩れてしまいます。先手は攻められる前に受けの手を指す必要がありました。
explain.en: White has a tesuji of sacrificing the knight with △8六桂 and attacking all at once, which collapses the boat castle. Black needed to make a defensive move before being attacked.

section.en: The horse can also be used for defense

title.ja: 図1-6 馬は自陣に引け
title.en: Figure 1-6: Retreat the horse to your camp

explain.ja: 図1-4からは、敵陣にある馬を引きつけて▲7七馬とするのがよい手です。これで囲いが強固になり、後手の速い攻めはなくなります。「馬は自陣に引け」「馬の守りは金銀3枚」という格言もあります。
explain.en: From Figure 1-4, pulling the horse back from the enemy camp with ▲7七馬 is a good move. It strengthens the castle and removes White's fast attack. There are proverbs such as "retreat the horse to your camp" and "a horse's defence equals three gold/silver".

section.en: The horse can also be used for defense

title.en: Figure 2-1: Fork with the bishop

explain.ja: ここから角を使った手筋を紹介します。「角での両取り」「筋違いの角打ち」「角と桂馬を組み合わせた攻め」「攻防の角」の4つです。まず両取りで、角は動ける範囲が広いので両取りを仕掛けられる局面が多くなります。図2-1はいわゆる王手飛車です。
explain.en: Here are tesuji using the bishop: bishop forks, the off-file bishop drop, attacks combining bishop and knight, and the two-way bishop. First, forks: the bishop has a wide range, so many positions allow a fork. Figure 2-1 is the so-called check-rook fork.

title.ja: 図2-2 角での両取りだが…
title.en: Figure 2-2: A fork with the bishop, but...

explain.ja: 図2-2も角を使った両取りですが、この局面では後手に受けがあるので注意が必要です。
explain.en: Figure 2-2 is also a bishop fork, but in this position White has a defence, so be careful.

title.ja: 図2-3 角を合わせられて受けられる
title.en: Figure 2-3: Defended by interposing a bishop

explain.ja: △3三角とすれば両取りを受けられてしまいます。「角には角」という格言があり、角での攻めは角で受けられることが多いです。
explain.en: △3三角 defends against the fork. As the saying goes, "bishop answers bishop": a bishop attack is often met by a bishop.

title.ja: 図3-1 序盤から馬を作るには？
title.en: Figure 3-1: How to make a horse from the opening?

explain.ja: 図3-1は、初手から▲7六歩、△3四歩、▲2六歩、△3五歩、▲6八玉、△3二飛、▲2二角成、△同銀と進んだ局面です。実はここから馬を作れます。わかるでしょうか。
explain.en: Figure 3-1 comes after ▲7六歩, △3四歩, ▲2六歩, △3五歩, ▲6八玉, △3二飛, ▲2二角成, △同銀. In fact, a horse can be made from here. Can you see how?

title.ja: 図3-2 筋違いの角打ち
title.en: Figure 3-2: Off-file bishop drop

explain.ja: 図3-1から▲6五角と打てば、後手は次の▲4三角成と▲8三角成を同時には受けられません。このように6五または4五に打つ角を「筋違いの角」と言います。角交換の将棋では筋違いの角打ちが生じやすいので、駒組みに注意しましょう。
explain.en: In Figure 3-1, dropping ▲6五角 means White cannot stop both ▲4三角成 and ▲8三角成. A bishop dropped on 6五 or 4五 like this is the "sujichigai bishop" (off-file bishop). In games with a bishop exchange it arises easily, so be careful when arranging your pieces.

title.en: Figure 3-3: Off-file bishop

explain.ja: 初手から▲7六歩、△3四歩、▲2二角成、△同銀、▲4五角といきなり筋違いに角を打つ戦法もあり、そのまま「筋違い角」と呼ばれます。
explain.en: There is also a strategy of dropping the bishop off-file right away: ▲7六歩, △3四歩, ▲2二角成, △同銀, ▲4五角. It is simply called Sujichigai Kaku (Off-File Bishop).

title.ja: 図4-1 どのように攻める？
title.en: Figure 4-1: How to attack?

explain.ja: 図4-1を考えます。後手は美濃囲いに組んでいますが、ここから3手で詰みます。
explain.en: Consider Figure 4-1. White has built a Mino castle, but it is mated in three moves from here.

section.ja: 角と桂馬を組み合わせた攻め

title.ja: 図4-2 後手は桂馬をとれない
title.en: Figure 4-2: White cannot capture the knight

explain.ja: 図4-1から▲7四桂と打つのが正解です。後手はこの桂馬を△同歩と取りたいところですが、そうすると玉が角の効きに入ってしまいます。
explain.en: ▲7四桂 is the answer from Figure 4-1. White would like to capture the knight with △同歩, but that puts the king in the bishop's line of attack.

section.ja: 角と桂馬を組み合わせた攻め

title.ja: 図4-3 どう応じても金打ちで詰み
title.en: Figure 4-3: Checkmate by a gold drop however White responds

explain.ja: 図4-2からは後手玉がどこに逃げても▲8二金で詰みです。これは美濃囲いの弱点を突く攻め筋です。
explain.en: From Figure 4-2, wherever White's king flees, ▲8二金 is mate. This attack exploits a weakness of the Mino castle.

section.ja: 角と桂馬を組み合わせた攻め

title.ja: 図5-1 自玉に詰めろがかかっている
title.en: Figure 5-1: A mate threat is on your king

explain.ja: 図5-1では、次に△5八金と打たれると自玉が詰むので、何か受ける必要があります。次に詰みがある状態が「詰めろ」です。
explain.en: In Figure 5-1, △5八金 next would mate our king, so a defence is needed. A state with a mate threatened next is a tsumero.

section.en: Bishop on both attack and defense

title.en: Figure 5-2: Bishop drop for attack and defense

explain.ja: ここでは▲7六角と打つのが好手です。自玉の詰めろを防ぎつつ、次の▲3二角成で相手玉が詰みます。このように受けにも攻めにも働く角打ちを「攻防の角」と言います。角は動ける範囲が広いため、こうした攻防手が生じやすいです。これは「詰めろ逃れの詰めろ」でもあります。
explain.en: ▲7六角 is a good move here. It stops the threat to our own king while threatening ▲3二角成 next, which would mate the opponent. A bishop drop that works for both attack and defence is called a "kōbō no kaku" (two-way bishop). The bishop has a wide range, so such moves arise easily. This is also a "tsumero that escapes a tsumero".

section.en: Bishop on both attack and defense
